verdict.rationale: The Kimi API Platform publishes a downloadable, unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.1.0 document covering chat completions, responses, messages, batches, files and models. It also publishes a separate date-versioned Admin API OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, which satisfies the story directly. Probes note this spec belongs to the Open Platform, which the vendor distinguishes from the consumer assistant/membership product. No spec is evidenced for the assistant app or for the Kimi Code API itself. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the spec download, a spec covering the Kimi Code/assistant surface rather than only the separate Open Platform

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("Moonshot AI API", "API for Moonshot AI / Kimi large language model services", server https://api.moonshot.ai
a second OpenAPI document (3.0.3) carrying a date-based version (2026-10-20-beta).
